verdict.rationale: The axis applies because AMD's Instinct ecosystem documents Spur, a first-party AI-native job scheduler with GPU-first scheduling that is drop-in compatible with Slurm. The evidence is a single one-line mention, though, and says nothing about recurring or cron-style scheduling or multi-step workflows. Missing for 10: documented recurring/periodic job scheduling, workflow orchestration, in-depth Spur documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
